projects.name: TalentOS
projects.short_description: AI-native applicant tracking proof of concept: auditable scoring, semantic search, and recruiter copilots.
projects.description: TalentOS is an AI-native ATS proof of concept designed to replace brittle keyword screening with evidence-backed, rubric-weighted evaluation. It models the full hiring pipeline: multi-tenant job/rubric setup, async resume ingestion, structured extraction, hybrid semantic retrieval, citation-verified scoring, interview copilot workflows, and observability for cost/latency/quality.
features: Async resume ingestion with deterministic parsing and schema validation
Evidence-backed scoring with citation verification guardrails
Hybrid talent search (SQL filters + vector retrieval)
AI ops telemetry for latency, cost, and quality

projects.name: Waly_Presentation
projects.short_description: Offline AI presentation factory proof of concept: Markdown to styled PPTX/PDF with deterministic pipelines.
projects.description: Waly_Presentation is an offline AI presentation factory that converts structured Markdown into polished presentation artifacts. It uses an agent-style pipeline for planning and layout routing, a catalog of 30 design archetypes, and deterministic rendering engines for PPTX and PDF export. The project demonstrates practical AI product engineering: controllable workflows, reproducible outputs, and local-first execution.
features: Agent-style planning, parsing, and layout routing
PyQt6 studio for theme selection and export
Deterministic artifact generation with local outputs

reviews.reviewText: Osama brings strong AI engineering discipline: clear architecture, measurable evaluation, and practical delivery from prototype to usable product.
